verdict.rationale: USCIS's own Torch platform offers a FOIA/Privacy Act API that lets a subject, or someone acting on their behalf, request their Alien File material and track that request. This is a first-party route to obtaining one's own records, but it is a request process rather than a self-service export, and it only covers A-File material. Missing for 10: self-service account data export, documented open/machine-readable export formats, coverage of all account data (filings, case history), and any account-closure or portability guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: This API allows consumers to create a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) or Privacy Act (PA) request, for Alien File material, about or on behalf of the subject of record.
You can check the status of the FOIA/PA Alien File Request by using the Request Number returned from the newly created case.
